message.content: In Ancient Greece, **Solon** (c. 630–560 BCE) was the most famous lawmaker who established laws and reforms in Athens. He is credited with creating a legal framework that reduced debt slavery, restructured the social classes, and introduced measures to promote fairness and reduce corruption.
